claims.claim_text: For a clock sync alarm that comes and goes a few times a day, check the sync source priority first, since a wobbling primary reference tends to cause that and as far as he knows it doesn't mean the port is bad. Set the secondary reference properly and watch it for a day before replacing anything.
claims.symptom: clock sync alarm on interface coming up a few times a day
claims.action: set the secondary reference properly and watch it for a day
